scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Dragon Fruit Vikas Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must own agricultural land between 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and 10 acres (4 ha)
Applicant must be registered on the DBT portal

Applicant must be a resident of one of the following districts: Bhojpur, Gopalganj, Jehanabad, Saran, Siwan, Supaul, Aurangabad, Begusarai, Bhagalpur, Gaya, Katihar, Kishanganj, Munger, Muzaffarpur, Nalanda, West Champaran, Patna, East Champaran, Purniyan, Samastipur, Vaishali
benefits_summary: Financial support of up to ₹1,80,000 per hectare in the first year and ₹60,000 per hectare in the second and third years.
